title: WP_REST_API_Menu_Item
description: A menu item in a REST API context.

title.description: The title for the menu item.

raw.description: Title for the menu item, as it exists in the database.

rendered.description: HTML title for the menu item, transformed for display.

id.description: Unique identifier for the menu item.

type_label.description: The singular label used to describe this type of menu item.

type.description: The family of objects originally represented.

status.description: A named status for the menu item.

parent.description: The ID for the parent of the menu item.

attr_title.description: Text for the title attribute of the link element for this menu item.

classes.description: Class names for the link element of this menu item.

description.description: The description of this menu item.

menu_order.description: The DB ID of the nav_menu_item that is this item's menu parent, if any, otherwise 0.

object.description: The type of object originally represented, such as "category", "post", or "attachment".

object_id.description: The database ID of the original object this menu item represents, for example the ID for posts or the term_id for categories.

target.description: The target attribute of the link element for this menu item.

url.description: The URL to which this menu item points.

xfn.description: The XFN relationship expressed in the link of this menu item.

invalid.description: Whether the menu item represents an object that no longer exists.

menus.description: The terms assigned to the menu item in the nav_menu taxonomy.

_embedded.description: The embedded representation of relations. Only present when the '_embed' query parameter is set.

wp:term.description: The taxonomy terms for the nav menu item.
